source: Written 2026-10-14 from Scryfall oracle text verified that day for every card in the list, and this deck's notes. Printed power (Bloodghast 2, Teacher's Pest 1, Vraska 4) is from the enriched attrs snapshot, matching the notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: Dina, Essence Brewer — Witherbloom aristocrats
scenes.sub: Sacrifice a creature every turn. Draw, grow, and drain.
scenes.say: Dina, Essence Brewer. Witherbloom aristocrats. Sacrifice a creature every turn, then draw, grow, and drain.

scenes.head: Ability one: a card for a sacrifice
scenes.sub: Whenever you sacrifice a creature, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

scenes.head: Ability two: the ratchet
scenes.sub: {2}, {T}, sacrifice another creature: gain X life and put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.
scenes.say: Ability two, the ratchet. Pay two, tap Dina, and sacrifice another creature. You gain X life and put X plus one plus one counters on target creature you control, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.

scenes.head: A metronome, not a bomb
scenes.sub: Sacrificing nine bodies in one turn still draws one card. One sacrifice every turn draws every turn, so make that sacrifice free.

scenes.head: Mulligan rule
scenes.sub: Keep three or four lands. Keep two only with acceleration: [[Sol Ring]], [[Arcane Signet]], [[Elvish Mystic]] or [[Gilded Goose]].

scenes.head: Feed her. Load the ratchet. Drain the table.
scenes.sub: Three clips follow, one for each.

scenes.head: Sacrifice outlets with no mana cost
scenes.sub: [[Viscera Seer]]: sacrifice a creature, scry 1. [[Umbral Collar Zealot]]: sacrifice another creature or artifact, surveil 1. [[High Market]]: tap, sacrifice a creature, gain 1 life.

scenes.head: Fodder: a Pest every upkeep
scenes.sub: [[Beledros Witherbloom]] makes a 1/1 Pest at the beginning of each upkeep, yours and every opponent's. Each Pest gains you 1 life when it dies.
scenes.say: Fodder: a Pest every upkeep. [[Beledros Witherbloom]] makes a one-one Pest at the beginning of each upkeep, yours and every opponent's. Each Pest gains you one life when it dies.

scenes.head: Fodder that remakes itself
scenes.sub: [[Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia|Jadar]]: a 2/2 decayed Zombie at your end step if you control no decayed creature. [[Ophiomancer]]: a 1/1 deathtouch Snake each upkeep if you control no Snakes.
scenes.say: Fodder that remakes itself. [[Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia|Jadar]] makes a two-two decayed Zombie at your end step, if you control no decayed creature. [[Ophiomancer]] makes a one-one deathtouch Snake each upkeep, if you control no Snakes.

scenes.head: Fodder that climbs back
scenes.sub: [[Bloodghast]] returns when a land you control enters. [[Nether Traitor]] returns for {B} when another creature goes to your graveyard from the battlefield. [[Teacher's Pest]] returns for {B}{G}.
scenes.say: Fodder that climbs back. [[Bloodghast]] can return whenever a land you control enters. [[Nether Traitor]] can return for one black mana whenever another creature goes to your graveyard from the battlefield. [[Teacher's Pest]] returns for black and green.

scenes.head: An opponent's upkeep
scenes.sub: [[Beledros Witherbloom|Beledros]] triggers: a Pest arrives on your side.

scenes.head: Feed it to Viscera Seer
scenes.sub: Scry 1. Dina draws her card for this turn, and the Pest's death gains you 1 life.
scenes.say: Feed it to [[Viscera Seer]]. Scry one. Dina draws her card for this turn, and the Pest's death gains you one life.

scenes.head: Once each turn — every player's turn
scenes.sub: The draw is live again on each opponent's turn. Five sacrifices in one turn still draw one card, so spread them out: one per turn, around the table.
scenes.say: Once each turn means every player's turn. The draw is live again on each opponent's turn. Five sacrifices in one turn still draw just one card, so spread them out: one per turn, all the way around the table.

scenes.head: Every activation loads the next
scenes.sub: Power becomes counters, and counters become next turn's X.

scenes.head: Turn 5: the setup
scenes.sub: Dina came down on turn 3, so she can tap. Beside her: [[Bloodghast]], [[Teacher's Pest]], [[Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia|Jadar]] and the 2/2 Zombie Jadar made last turn.
scenes.say: Turn five: the setup. Dina came down on turn three, so she can tap. Beside her: [[Bloodghast]], [[Teacher's Pest]], [[Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia|Jadar]], and the two-two Zombie Jadar made last turn.

scenes.head: Pay {2}, tap Dina, sacrifice the Zombie
scenes.sub: X is 2: gain 2 life and put two +1/+1 counters on Bloodghast. The sacrifice also draws Dina's card for the turn.
scenes.say: Pay two, tap Dina, and sacrifice the Zombie. X is two: you gain two life and put two plus one plus one counters on [[Bloodghast]]. The sacrifice also draws Dina's card for the turn.

scenes.head: End step: Jadar makes a new Zombie
scenes.sub: You control no decayed creature now, so a fresh 2/2 arrives. Bloodghast is a 4-power body.
scenes.say: End step: Jadar makes a new Zombie. You control no decayed creature now, so a fresh two-two arrives. And Bloodghast is now a four-power body.

scenes.head: Turn 6: sacrifice Bloodghast
scenes.sub: X is 4 now: gain 4 life and put four +1/+1 counters on Teacher's Pest, a body that can come back. Dina draws again.
scenes.say: Turn six: sacrifice [[Bloodghast]]. X is four now: gain four life and put four plus one plus one counters on [[Teacher's Pest]], a body that can come back. Dina draws again.

scenes.head: Then play your sixth land
scenes.sub: Landfall: [[Bloodghast]] returns from your graveyard. The card that paid for X = 4 is back, ready to be loaded again.
scenes.say: Then play your sixth land. Landfall: [[Bloodghast]] returns from your graveyard. The card that paid for X equals four is back, ready to be loaded again.

scenes.head: Load what comes back
scenes.sub: [[Teacher's Pest]] is 5 power now, so sacrificing it next turn makes X 5. Then it can return for {B}{G}, ready to load again.
scenes.say: Load what comes back. [[Teacher's Pest]] is five power now, so sacrificing it next turn makes X five. Then it can return for black and green, ready to load again.

scenes.head: Still turn 6: Vraska, removal first
scenes.sub: When [[Vraska, the Cutting Glare]] enters, if you control six or more lands, destroy target permanent an opponent controls. They create a Treasure token.
scenes.say: Still turn six, and Vraska comes in as removal first. When she enters, if you control six or more lands, destroy target permanent an opponent controls. They create a Treasure token.

scenes.head: Then she is a 4-power body
scenes.sub: Deathtouch on the battlefield now; later, a sacrifice to Dina for X = 4: four life and four counters.
scenes.say: Then she is a four-power body. Deathtouch on the battlefield now. Later, she's a sacrifice to Dina for X equals four: four life and four counters.

clips.title: How it wins: drain the table

scenes.head: Every death drains
scenes.sub: [[Blood Artist]]: whenever a creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1. [[Zulaport Cutthroat]]: whenever it or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 and you gain 1.

scenes.head: Every life gain drains
scenes.sub: [[Dina, Soul Steeper]]: whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1. It counts gains, not their size: gaining 5 drains 1.
scenes.say: Every life gain drains. [[Dina, Soul Steeper]]: whenever you gain life, each opponent loses one. It counts gains, not their size: gaining five life still drains just one.

scenes.head: Count one Pest
scenes.sub: [[Dina, Essence Brewer|Dina]], [[Viscera Seer]], Blood Artist, Zulaport and Soul Steeper are out. Sacrifice a Pest to the Seer.

scenes.head: Three gains, three more drains
scenes.sub: Blood Artist, Zulaport and the Pest each gain you 1. Soul Steeper drains for each. Every opponent loses 4, the Blood Artist target loses 5, and Dina draws.
scenes.say: Three gains, three more drains. Blood Artist, Zulaport and the Pest each gain you one life, and Soul Steeper drains for each one. Every opponent loses four, the Blood Artist target loses five, and Dina draws a card.

scenes.head: Big gains count in full
scenes.sub: [[Defiling Daemogoth]]: at your end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life you gained this turn. A ratchet activation that gains 4 adds 4.
scenes.say: Big gains count in full. [[Defiling Daemogoth]]: at your end step, each opponent loses life equal to the life you gained this turn. A ratchet activation that gains four adds four.

scenes.head: Make them sacrifice too
scenes.sub: [[Priest of Forgotten Gods]]: tap, sacrifice two other creatures. Any number of target players each lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature. You add {B}{B} and draw.
scenes.say: Make them sacrifice too. [[Priest of Forgotten Gods]]: tap it and sacrifice two other creatures. Any number of target players each lose two life and sacrifice a creature of their choice. You add two black mana and draw a card.

scenes.head: A wrath is coming? Cash in first.
scenes.sub: Sacrifice the board in response. You keep the drains, the graveyard fill and the cards.

scenes.head: Dina, Essence Brewer
scenes.sub: One sacrifice a turn: draw, load the ratchet, drain the table. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
